Meta Platforms, Inc. **Minute Entry for proceedings held before Judge Vince Chhabria: Further Case Management Conference held via Zoom on 10/29/2026 in case 3:23-cv-03417-VC; 3:25-cv-09579-VC; 3:26-cv-02333-VC; 3:26-cv-03725-VC; :26-cv-04053-VC; 3:26-cv-06793-VC. Initial Case Management Conference held via Zoom on 10/29/2026 in case 3:26-cv-11415-VC; 3:26-cv-11420-VC; 3:26-cv-12126-VC; 3:26-cv-12115-VC.**Court denies without prejudice Sullivan plaintiffs' motion to appoint interim lead counsel. Court revokes Boies Schiller's status as interim class counsel in the Kadrey case. Court will revisit appointment of interim class counsel. Court deems the parties to have requested that the cases be related: 3:26-cv-12100-LJC Winspear et al. v. Meta Platforms, Inc., 3:26-cv-12131-CRB Reno et al v. Meta Platforms, Inc., and 5:26-cv-12137-BLF Levine et al v. Meta Platforms, Inc. Court orders the cases related. Court issues an Order to Show Cause as to why the five recently filed individual cases should not be dismissed for improper joinder. Responses due 12/11/2026. Parties in the Kadrey case to begin class discovery. Parties in the Sullivan, Elsevier and the Hobbs cases to file a stipulation with their proposed briefing schedule for the Motion for Summary Judgment/Motion for Class Certification. Court permits Entrepreneur Media and the Three Cs to file amended complaints. Amended Complaints to be filed by 11/6/2026. Initial copies should be sent to Meta by 11/3/2026. Further Case Management Conference set for 12/11/2026 at 1:30 PM by Videoconference Only. Case Management Statement due by 12/4/2026.  Total Time in Court: 1 hour, 39 minutes. Court Reporter: Marla Knox.
